legal_obligor_name: Ararat Home of Los Angeles, Inc.

starting_ratings.note: Unrated obligor. Bonds Cal-Mortgage insured; underlying credit not publicly rated.

material_events_in_window: March 2023: acquired Ararat Gardens (former Windsor) Glendale CCRC, reimbursed via Cal-Mortgage insured Series 2023 ($10.485M, 5.85% AITIC, matures 12/31/2043).
2024-2025: CCN 555579 Ararat Nursing Facility (Mission Hills, 254 beds) carries CMS 1-star Overall Rating + SFF Candidate designation + Abuse Icon.
CMS enforcement (rolling 3yr window through May 2026): 9 fines totaling $460,840; 4 payment denials; 13 total penalties — among the highest penalty totals on our 14-obligor CA NH list.
Affiliated facility CCN 555126 (Ararat Convalescent Hospital, Eagle Rock, 42 beds) 4-star — no SFF.
Affiliated facility CCN 555616 (Ararat Post Acute, Glendale, 28 beds) 5-star, but Abuse Icon flagged.
verified_outcome.outcome_class_rationale: While obligor is unrated, the dominant SNF (Mission Hills, 254 beds = ~78% of bed count) is a CMS 1-star + SFF Candidate facility with $460,840 in CMP fines and an abuse-icon designation. SFF Candidate status plus 1-star Overall is the strongest possible CMS distress signal short of formal SFF designation. Triggers SFF detector + Star-rating detector + CMP detector simultaneously.

nh_cms_star_rating._note: Mission Hills facility (254 beds) is dominant SNF. Eagle Rock (CCN 555126, 42 beds): 4-star. Glendale Post Acute (CCN 555616, 28 beds): 5-star.
